60K likes, 762 comments - aarzoo_khurana on May 24, 2024: "Having lived a dream come true today, I am at a loss for words to describe the experience of meeting Sh. Ratan Tata Sir — a man of unmatched finesse, poise and, above all, humility. The towering great generations have looked up to was so kind and humble as to walk us to the door after an incisive interaction. 

So let me stop letting words repeatedly fail to do justice to the experience and just say this: Sir, you are a hero to all of us, and this picture with you is among my most prized possessions.

#dreamcometrue #aarzookhuranaphotography #aarzookhurana #ratantatasir #photooftheera #dreams #idol #happiness".

11K likes, 123 comments - aarzoo_khurana on October 29, 2026: "Although wildlife will always be my first love, I have been absolutely loving the Portrait Mode on the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra!

During my recent trip to Singalila National Park to photograph red pandas, I also captured some incredible portraits of people from nearby Nepal. Their expressions, skin textures, hair details, and the glint in their eyes caught my attention, so I quickly pulled out my S26 Ultra and started clicking.

Here are some of my favourites. Which one speaks to you the most? 

#collab #GalaxyS26Ultra #TeamGalaxy #withGalaxy @samsungindia

​".

9,347 likes, 60 comments - aarzoo_khurana on October 27, 2026: "Eight months with the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, and I have put it through its paces across genres, from wildlife and macro to telephoto and portraits.

The dynamic range in the clouds, the details in an elderly woman’s eyes, the scales of a green vine snake, the tiny eggs of a frog, the textures of water, and the intricate patterns on a peacock’s feathers. Every time, it has delivered beautiful results.

And it is not just about photography. From trips with friends to capturing selfies along the way, I have really enjoyed the selfie camera too.

Here are some of my favourite frames from the last eight months, celebrating the beauty in the little things.

Which one is your favourite?

#collab #GalaxyS26Ultra #TeamGalaxy #withGalaxy @samsungindia".
